claims: The 2026 Boston Marathon requires qualifying times ranging from 2:55:00 to 5:20:00 depending on age and gender.
Qualifying times are effective for 2026/2027 races.
Registration for the 2026 Boston Marathon is not guaranteed.
Due to high demand, a "cut-off" time is often applied.
2026 & 2027 Boston Marathon Qualifying Standards for age 18–34 men is 2:55:00
